name: immoadv-browser
description: ImmoAdv Browser 4 – ImmoAdv-Oberfläche auf dem Firefox-Motor (ESR): Google-Anmeldung, Passkeys, NordVPN, Blocker, Passwort-Tresor, KI-Assistent, Immobilien-Check
author: Feray Korkmaz

scripts.start: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-rules.mjs --offline && node scripts/build-extension.mjs && electron .
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-rules.mjs && node scripts/build-extension.mjs && node scripts/ensure-release.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-rules.mjs && node scripts/build-extension.mjs && node scripts/ensure-release.mjs && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
